content.title: Four-Stop Selfie Route | Local Action and Foreground Wipes
content.summary: A marine researcher links four coastal stops through foreground wipes. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult identity and selfie distance remain stable. + Each destination has one locational proof and one bounded action. + A physical foreground object motivates every location change. + Food or props do not replace the identity anchors. + The final location closes the route with the same traveler.
quick_start.recommended_input: Follow one adult marine researcher with short curls, a teal rain shell and a square brass earring through four coastal stops in an arm-length selfie. A hanging net wipes the lens and reveals a sunny fish market where she tastes one citrus slice. Her gloved palm covers the lens once and reveals the final research vessel deck under the exact title "FOUR TIDES".

invariants.rule: One adult identity and selfie distance remain stable.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One adult identity and selfie distance remain stable."

invariants.rule: Each destination has one locational proof and one bounded action.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each destination has one locational proof and one bounded action."

invariants.rule: A physical foreground object motivates every location change.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "A physical foreground object motivates every location change."

invariants.rule: Food or props do not replace the identity anchors.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Food or props do not replace the identity anchors."

invariants.rule: The final location closes the route with the same traveler.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final location closes the route with the same traveler."
